title: Flutter: auto-layout compositor — assemble widgets from game definition
description: BaizeGameView reads the game definition's zones and automatically composes the right widget layout. Grid/hex zones → BaizeBoard. Ordered stacks with private visibility → BaizeHand. Graph zones → BaizeGraph. Track zones → BaizeTrack. Counters → BaizeScore. Arranges them in a responsive layout: board centered, hand at bottom, scores at top, side zones in panels. No per-game custom code needed — the game definition drives the layout.
